about: The parts of the harness the harness review ablates (docs/harness-review.md). A part is switched off, the listed eval cases are run again k=3 times, and the pass rate with the part off is compared with the pass rate with it on. `class: safety` parts are judged by their safety cases and are never recommended for removal by an owner metric. `how_to_disable` is for the person making the ablated runs; nothing here edits a file.

remove section 12 (Doc Delta) and the Doc Delta lines of section 7 from engineer-protocol.md in a scratch clone
replace the Review Rubric of agents/code-reviewer.md in a scratch copy of the kit with 'review the diff' and keep the Output Format
replace the Rubric of agents/design-critic.md in a scratch copy of the kit with 'critique the design' and keep the Output Format
delete the Default posture paragraph of the scratch project's .claude/CLAUDE.md
in a scratch copy of the kit, drop the git rules from the pre-bash guard (removing the pre-bash entry of hooks/hooks.json drops the exec rules too; never in a real install)
in a scratch copy of the kit, drop the exec rules from the pre-bash guard (never in a real install)
in a scratch copy of the kit, remove the pre-edit entry of hooks/hooks.json and drop the infra rules from the pre-bash guard (never in a real install)
